2869.title: Side-chat queue is absent during a user question
2869.rootCauseOneLine: The interaction banner replaces the prompt box that owns the queue stack.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff keeps the queue visible and corrects standalone card spacing; queue mutation policy still needs an explicit test.

2869.proposedFix: Keep the queue and interaction in one footer stack, and use explicit standalone queue-card styles.
2869.caveats: The live provider session could not authenticate. Two clean component tests and a real app with valid persisted records reproduced the UI defect.
